properties.name: auth.jwt.access-token-expiry-ms
properties.description: Access token lifetime in milliseconds (default 15 minutes).

properties.name: auth.jwt.refresh-token-expiry-ms
properties.description: Refresh token lifetime in milliseconds (default 7 days).

properties.name: auth.jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC-SHA signing secret. Must be at least 32 bytes (256 bits) for HS256. Injected from a secrets manager in production.

properties.name: auth.password-reset.lockout-duration-ms
properties.description: Temporary lockout duration after exceeding max attempts (milliseconds). Default 15 minutes.

properties.name: auth.password-reset.max-failed-login-attempts
properties.description: Maximum consecutive failed login attempts before temporary lockout.

properties.name: auth.password-reset.return-token-in-response
properties.description: When {@code true} the raw reset token is returned in the forgot-password response. This is for development/testing only. In production this MUST be {@code false} and the token must be delivered out-of-band (e.g. email).

properties.name: auth.password-reset.token-expiry-ms
properties.description: Reset token lifetime in milliseconds (default 1 hour).
